oneLiner: Web app that instantly splits and tracks shared trip expenses without spreadsheets.
problem: Travel groups waste time and make errors when manually calculating, splitting, and settling shared costs using spreadsheets or ad‑hoc messages.
targetUser: Friends, families, and small tour organizers who need a quick, collaborative way to manage trip expenses.
coreFlow: Invite participants via email or link
Add expenses with payer and participants

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Shows a list of active trips and quick actions to create or join a trip.

screens.name: Trip Detail
screens.purpose: Displays all recorded expenses, participant list, and real‑time balances.

screens.name: Add Expense
screens.purpose: Form for entering expense amount, description, payer, and participants to split.

screens.name: Settlement Summary
screens.purpose: Summarizes who owes whom, with simple pay‑back suggestions.

screens.name: Invite & Settings
screens.purpose: Allows trip creator to invite new members, edit trip details, and set currency.

outOfScope: Direct bank or payment gateway integrations
